title: Super-Stealth trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Super-Stealth; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #149 resource at file offset 0x2fa900, control 272, caption 'Super-Stealth'; style 0x50000009 (BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON)
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Super-Stealth and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Super-Stealth changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Starts with Electronics tech 5, one scout and one colony ship (documented-only).
Exclusive Rogue and Stealth Bomber hulls and the listed scanner, shield, armor and cloak components (documented-only).
All ships and starbases have an inherent 75% cloak (documented-only).
Travels through opponent minefields at one warp speed faster than the Technology Browser limit (documented-only).
Gains research from spying: resources in each field equal half the average spent in that field by all races while at least one other race exists (documented-only).

unresolved: Cloak stacking and rounding rules are unknown.
The spy-research average denominator and rounding are unknown.
Minefield-speed order relative to other movement modifiers is unknown.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
